milestone: M8.1 (track M8 — THE IPHONE PASS, opened 2026-11-10)
intent: The user pointed at FoundPhone-Studio (github.com/keoyyo85/foundphone-studio — an iPhone 15 Pro / iOS 18 virtual-phone story framework, cloned for reference at /tmp/foundphone-studio) and asked for the phone to have 'the same iphone interface', with the plan broken into milestones that each end in a checkpoint so sessions can compact and regroup continuously. Track decision recorded in docs/GAME-PLAN.md M8 (best practices adopted: device metrics as constants, token-layer CSS, pure layout logic + tests, code-drawn icons, one-file-per-app; NOT adopted: their story engine, IndexedDB, 49-app catalog, authoring UI — blackglass's engine + signal desk and the cgAI_ localStorage canon stay). M8.1 delivered the device shell: an iOS token layer on the iPhone 15 Pro grid with the per-phone glassOS theme riding above it, the status bar in iOS glyph grammar (time · island · signal/wifi/battery, diegetic mute + power + bell kept), and a dynamic island that floats above every overlay like real hardware.

smoke_fixes: scripts/lib/nav.mjs — launchAuditBrowser (Chromium --disable-async-dns: its async DNS resolver stalls under WSL2's NAT resolver; navigation never commits with zero requests logged — proven by A/B probe) + gotoHub(page, BASE) (proves the hub per host base instead of assuming the URL)
hub-smoke — mounts through gotoHub and gates on the hero heading before any soft assertion (an unmounted page now fails legibly at the gate)
os-smoke — proves the radar destination before skipping its fallback; falls in through the hub's feed-desk station per host base

anthology-smoke — gotoGame proves the mount with a bounded waitFor (fixed 600ms settle fired before React mount on live), discovers the hub-rendering path per host, and enters through [data-od-id="station-rack"] (GitHub Pages has no SPA fallback for deep links; the old fallback locator was pre-M6.7 brochure text)
follow-up recorded: exam/radar/case-os direct-link probes still assume a host base (passed locally + on Pages; latent conflation on the other base)
ops_learnings: docs/HANDOFF.md §7b — three failure modes captured: (1) Chromium async-DNS stall under WSL2 (signature: curl fast + browser no-commit + empty request log = resolver, not the site), (2) never compare bundle hashes across vite bases (Workers base / vs Pages /blackglass/ — 40-min false alarm), (3) smokes must prove destinations and mounts, not responses and sleeps
